## [1.3.2](https://github.com/6zev/morphe-patches/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2) (2026-11-02)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* neutralise every trap, and the anti-tamper constructor on 32-bit ([4c9ce8c](https://github.com/6zev/morphe-patches/commit/4c9ce8c6d26da3aa52aedae3530cab4736df93e5))

patches.name: Unlock native engine
patches.description: Patches the native engine library (libd.so) so that it loads on a re-signed APK. The anti-tamper constructor that destroys a global mutex is disabled, and the trap instructions the verification routine plants inside its own code - udf #0 (SIGILL) and stores of the markers 0xdead and 0xdeadbeef (SIGSEGV) - are replaced by no-ops, leaving the routine's work intact. This is what makes Web Widget Overlay and button emulation work.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Makes the bundled Google LVL policy always report the app as licensed, which unlocks the premium features.
